interpretation: The bounded whole-circuit solver timed out. The partitioned comparison produced a counterexample whose internal input assignments violate their signal definitions. Replaying its external and state inputs on the original circuits produced zero differing boundary outputs. This does not establish equivalence of the original circuits, and is not a reproduced functional counterexample to them.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys,time
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/mapping-proof';sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'));import cad
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def interface(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();pos=data.index(b'\n');header=data[:pos].split();assert header[0]==b'aig' and len(header)==6,header
 m,i,l,o,a=map(int,header[1:]);assert l==0
 pos+=1
 for _ in range(o):pos=data.index(b'\n',pos)+1
 for _ in range(2*a):
  while True:
   v=data[pos];pos+=1
   if v<128:break
 names={}
 for line in data[pos:].decode('ascii').splitlines():
  if line=='c':break
  match=re.fullmatch(r'([io])(\d+) (.+)',line)
  if match:names[(match[1],int(match[2]))]=match[3]
 return ([names['i',n] for n in range(i)],[names['o',n] for n in range(o)])
assert interface(out/'reference.aig')==interface(out/'candidate.aig'),'positional interfaces differ'
inputs=json.loads((out/'inputs.json').read_text())
for name,digest in inputs['inputs'].items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
files=[out/'reference.aig',out/'candidate.aig',out/'cells.v',Path(__file__).resolve(),root/'tools/ecp5_ram.py',root/'tools/cad.py',cad.SUITE/'libexec/yosys-abc']
extra={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in files}
args=cad.command('yosys-abc')+['-c','&cec -T 600 -C 100000 '+str(out/'reference.aig')+' '+str(out/'candidate.aig')]
start=time.monotonic()
with (out/'modern-equivalence.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(args,env=cad.environment(),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log=(out/'modern-equivalence.log').read_text();print(log[-3000:],flush=True)
for name,digest in {**inputs['inputs'],**extra}.items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
passed=r.returncode==0 and any(line.startswith('Networks are equivalent') for line in log.splitlines())
result={'equivalent':passed,'exit_code':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'inputs':inputs,'extra_inputs':extra,'positional_interfaces_verified':True,'command':args,'log_sha256':sha(out/'modern-equivalence.log')}
(out/'modern-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');assert passed,'equivalence not established'

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'build/mapping-proof';out=base/'named';log=(out/'modern-equivalence.log').read_text()
assignments={n:(int(w),int(v,16)) for n,w,v in re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*) = (\d+)'h([0-9a-fA-F]+)",log.split('INPUT: ',1)[1].split('OUTPUT:',1)[0])}
def evaluate(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();pos=data.index(b'\n');header=data[:pos].split();assert header[0]==b'aig' and len(header)==6
 maximum,count,latches,output_count,and_count=map(int,header[1:]);assert latches==0
 pos+=1;outputs=[]
 for _ in range(output_count):
  end=data.index(b'\n',pos);outputs.append(int(data[pos:end]));pos=end+1
 start=pos
 for _ in range(2*and_count):
  while data[pos]&128:pos+=1
  pos+=1
 names={}
 for line in data[pos:].decode('ascii').splitlines():
  if line=='c':break
  match=re.fullmatch(r'([io])(\d+) (.+)',line)
  if match:names[match[1],int(match[2])]=match[3]
 values=bytearray(maximum+1)
 for i in range(count):
  name=names['i',i];match=re.fullmatch(r'(.+)\[(\d+)\]',name)
  port,bit=(match[1],int(match[2])) if match else (name,0)
  width,value=assignments[port];assert bit<width,(port,bit,width)
  values[i+1]=(value>>bit)&1
 pos=start
 def varint():
  nonlocal pos
  v=0;shift=0
  while True:
   byte=data[pos];pos+=1;v|=(byte&127)<<shift
   if byte<128:return v
   shift+=7
 for i in range(and_count):
  lhs=count+i+1;a=2*lhs-varint();b=a-varint()
  assert a//2<lhs and b//2<lhs
  values[lhs]=(values[a//2]^(a&1))&(values[b//2]^(b&1))
 return {names['o',i]:values[v//2]^(v&1) for i,v in enumerate(outputs)}
reference=evaluate(base/'reference.aig');candidate=evaluate(base/'candidate.aig');assert reference.keys()==candidate.keys()
differences=[name for name in reference if reference[name]!=candidate[name]]
partition_reference=evaluate(out/'reference.aig');partition_candidate=evaluate(out/'candidate.aig')
partition_differences=[name for name in partition_reference if partition_reference[name]!=partition_candidate[name]]
inconsistent_internal_inputs={}
for label,values in [('reference',partition_reference),('candidate',partition_candidate)]:
 inconsistent_internal_inputs[label]=sum(value!=assignments[name.replace('internal_definition_','internal_input_')][1] for name,value in values.items() if name.startswith('internal_definition_'))
print('Internal assignments violating their definitions:',inconsistent_internal_inputs)
print('Original circuit differences:',len(differences),differences[:10]);print('Partitioned differences:',len(partition_differences),partition_differences[:10])
result={'inconsistent_internal_input_counts':inconsistent_internal_inputs,'original_boundary_differences':differences,'partitioned_boundary_differences':partition_differences,'counterexample_reproduces_on_original_circuits':bool(differences),'inputs':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [base/'reference.aig',base/'candidate.aig',out/'reference.aig',out/'candidate.aig',out/'modern-equivalence.log',Path(__file__).resolve()]}}
(out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
